title: Wire messages and recipient acceptance receipts
description: Use existing /msg/inbox and /msg/ack codecs/resources, protected by real endpoint OSCORE. Python local send currently archives/delivers locally; Rust resource stores are not runtime-wired and RplStack public secure path is GET-only; C msg_send only queues and standalone inbox callback is unset. Automatic recipient receipt and authenticated sent-record correlation missing/incomplete. Direct IPv6/CoAP LCI is authoritative, not POST/msg/sent convenience API. Preserve message uint64 ID, full recipient identity, ack:true and existing receipt-window semantics. Connected short-message slice excludes offline-custody scenarios, not a claim of complete custody conformance.
acceptance_criteria: Client submission reaches recipient handler through relay; acceptance generates specified protected receipt after configured receipt window; sender verifies expected recipient and outstanding message ID; no relay/TX/queued event reports delivery.
